verification.functional_equivalence: With identical random state, native and pinned upstream evaluation produced bit-identical encoder/codes/scale/decoded waveform results for odd-length 641-sample 24 kHz and 48 kHz inputs, plus a three-segment 48 kHz overlap-add case.
verification.method: HTTPS range reads of each PyTorch zip central directory and archive/data.pkl, followed by a symbolic restricted pickle walk that materialized no tensor storage payloads
verification.result: Generated native names, dtypes, shapes, tensor counts, state-value counts, and sorted inventory fingerprints match both published artifacts exactly.

voicehub_changes: Replaced einops rearrange/repeat operations with PyTorch transpose, reshape, and expand.
Removed torchaudio and provider-library runtime imports.
Added strict public validation, deterministic native export, atomic official artifact transport, and lazy package imports.
Detached RVQ residual updates during training to fix the later-stage zero-gradient defect documented in facebookresearch/encodec issue 25; forward values and checkpoint state remain unchanged.
Fixed the unused upstream ConvLayerNorm forward return while preserving released graph behavior.
